records.rule: rasenfalcon_ldap_service.rex restores persistent Identity Directory state, requires ACTIVE resource:directory, materialises secrets only through Secret Broker mappings and serves mandatory LDAPS.
rasenfalcon-ldap.service runs as the dedicated rasenfalcon-ldap identity with hardened systemd protections and narrow writable state/runtime paths.
The daemon never provisions people, ACLs, credentials or service accounts at startup; provisioning remains an external reviewed authority.
The rehearsal joins native LDAP wire semantics, NoSQL restart recovery, STARTTLS/LDAPS, Access Permissions and principal revocation/admission.
Human, CHATGPT and CLAUDE are distinct principals; rights do not cross without explicit grants.
LDAP authentication is not signature verification and neither one alone grants EMAIL_SEND.
Private HTTPS admission requires attributed active principal plus explicit HTTPS_LOGIN authority.
LDAP remains NOT_INSTALLED until owned Deployment and operator-gated live acceptance complete.
